preconditions.expression: isinstance(S, str) and all(c.isalnum() or c == '-' for c in S)
preconditions.description: S is a string consisting of only alphanumeric characters and dashes.
K is an integer greater than or equal to 1.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isupper() or c == '-' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output string contains only uppercase letters and dashes.

postconditions.expression: all(len(group) == K for group in return_value.split('-')[1:])
postconditions.description: Each group except the first contains exactly K characters.
The first group contains at least one character and at most K characters.

postconditions.expression: all('-' not in group for group in return_value.split('-'))
